name: std::basic_ofstream<CharT,Traits>::open
intro:
Opens and associates the file with name filename with the file stream.

Calls clear() on success. Calls setstate(failbit) on failure.

1,2) Effectively calls rdbuf()->open(filename, mode | ios_base::out) (see std::basic_filebuf::open for the details on the effects of that call). Overload (2) is only provided if std::filesystem::path::value_type is not char.(since C++17)

3,4) Effectively calls (1,2) as if by open(filename.c_str(), mode).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
filename

 -

 the name of the file to be opened


 mode

 -

 specifies stream open mode. It is a BitmaskType, the following constants are defined:



 Constant

 Explanation




 app

 seek to the end of stream before each write




 binary

 open in binary mode




 in

 open for reading




 out

 open for writing




 trunc

 discard the contents of the stream when opening




 ate

 seek to the end of stream immediately after open




 noreplace (C++23)

 open in exclusive mode
